en: Welcome to the Ferris wheel! One turn takes in the whole of Nimbasa City, the stadiums and the sea beyond.
Step into the car, please. Enjoy the view!
The car climbs slowly over the amusement park. The stadiums, the Gear Station and the river spread out below...
Far off to the west, a long bridge reaches across the water toward a city of warehouses.
The car climbs slowly into the dark. Below, the whole of Nimbasa glitters like a box of jewels...
Far off to the west, the lights of a long bridge stretch across the black water.
The car sways gently as it comes back down to the ground.
Welcome back! The view is different every time. Ride again whenever you like!
No hurry! The wheel turns all day and all night.
